text:
Decision models need their own inference engine.

So we developed Flide, a high-performance and exact inference engine for Jev-like decision models.

Flide achieves up to a 9.5x speedup over vLLM and SGLang.

It now supports 30+ popular local Jev-like decision models.

Start to make your decision immediately:

pip install flide
title: Show HN: Flide: Make Jev-like decision models up to 9.5x faster
